how: Walls are the dark lines of the plan image; rooms are the spaces they enclose, with door gaps closed by extending each wall end up to 2 m. The plan was fitted to the ground with a similarity transform on 7 control points (4500EL over floor 2 500EL; 4500ST over floor 2 500ST; 4200ST over floor 2 200ST; 4401ST over floor 2 401ST; 4700ST over floor 2 700ST; 4700EL over floor 2 700EL; 4200EL over floor 2 200EL).
notes: Room numbers are read from the plan's label boxes. Suffixes: CO and CU are corridors, ST stairs, EL elevators (UCLA Space Inventory codes).
